name: saga-dsl
description: Pure Saga plan producer: explicit legacy Scala or strict contract-only IR consumption; strict runnable source blocked until a runtime API shape is verified

output.productMeaning: template denotes physical source/contract artifacts, not a new core Saga product

options.binding: strict modes require a closed truthsrc.saga-binding/v1 document
options.ir: optional exact compileSagas(canonical,binding) IR in strict modes
options.legacySagaSpecs: legacy mode requires complete, strictly shaped specs; no canonical Saga downgrade
